items.title: Malaysia introduces new regulated sea areas
items.summary: Malaysia has introduced two new regulated sea areas near the eastern approaches to the Traffic Separation Scheme in the Straits of Malacca and Singapore. The regulations affect routing, anchoring, speed, cargo transfer and bunkering operations.

items.title: Cyber security controls for existing ships
items.summary: While mandatory cyber resilience requirements primarily apply to newbuilds, cyber threats affect ships regardless of age. IACS Recommendation No. 194 provides a practical baseline for strengthening cyber security controls across existing fleets.

items.title: Loss of bridge control in functioning systems
items.summary: Effective control of a vessel can sometimes be lost even when equipment is working. In this article, we see how control settings applied by the crew can lead to serious accidents. In an era of increasingly sophisticated bridges and integrated systems, the accidents serve as a stark reminder of risks

items.title: Fish farm claims in China: lessons from a recent court judgement
items.summary: Fish farm contact incidents remain a recurring issue for vessels trading to Chinese coastal waters. Traditionally, such claims can be difficult for owners to defend, particularly where liability is argued from the mere fact that a vessel entered an aquaculture area. A recent Chinese maritime court j

items.title: Preventing auxiliary engine overspeed
items.summary: Overspeed can occur within seconds, perhaps from a simple setup error or a seemingly minor mechanical fault. The result can be severe engine damage, costly repairs and weeks out of service. Here are some of the key steps to reduce the risk.
items.summary_zh: 輔助機械過轉可能在數秒內發生，原因可能是簡單的設定錯誤或看似輕微的機械故障。後果可能導致嚴重的引擎損壞、高昂的維修費用以及數週的停航。文中建議採取一些關鍵步驟以降低此類風險。

items.title: Precautions against liquefaction when loading iron ore fines in India
items.summary: Gard once again alerts Members and clients to the significant risks associated with bulk cargo liquefaction. The recent tragic loss of life of crew on a bulk carrier in the Bay of Bengal has renewed concerns regarding the safety of some iron ore fines shipments, particularly from ports on the east c
items.summary_zh: Gard再次提醒會員注意散裝貨液化風險。近期一艘散貨船於孟加拉灣發生船員死亡事故，重新引發對東海岸港口裝載之鐵礦砂細粉運輸安全的關注。船舶裝載此類貨物時須嚴格遵守IMSBC規則中關於鐵礦砂細粉的運輸條件，特別是裝載前確認其流動水分點（FMP）試驗結果及貨艙含水量限制，避免裝載後因水分過高及振動導致貨物液化與船舶傾覆。建議加強裝載前檢查與船上監控，確保符合安全運輸要求。

items.title: El Niño, Panama Canal restrictions, and routing off Cape Horn
items.summary: The Panama Canal remains the preferred route for vessels trading between the Atlantic and Pacific Oceans. However, recurring drought conditions associated with the El Niño phenomenon have repeatedly reduced water availability in the Canal's watershed, forcing the Panama Canal Authority (ACP) to intr
items.summary_zh: 聖嬰現象反覆造成巴拿馬運河流域缺水,巴拿馬運河管理局(ACP)因而實施船舶通行管制與限制,使部分船舶改航合恩角以維持船期。巴拿馬運河仍為大西洋與太平洋間貿易的首選航線,但乾旱風險持續,船隊應提前評估運河管制對航程與船期的影響。

items.title: Cargo securing on the PSC agenda
items.summary: As port state control authorities prepare to step up inspections of cargo securing arrangements, ship operators should ensure that manuals and procedures are in line with IMO requirements and guidance, that securing equipment is in good working order, and that crews are properly trained.
items.summary_zh: 港口國管制當局將加強貨物繫固安排檢查，船東應確保繫固手冊與程序符合IMO要求與指引，繫固設備狀態良好，並對船員進行妥善訓練。

items.title: AIS-assisted collisions: The risks of over-reliance
items.summary: AIS has evolved into an important safety aid for situational awareness and even collision avoidance. However, this evolution also brings new risks, and over-reliance on AIS may, in some cases, contribute to incidents rather than prevent them.
items.summary_zh: AIS雖然已成為重要的安全輔助工具，但過度依賴AIS可能在某些情況下導致事故，而非預防事故。

items.title: Focus on seafarer wellbeing – a reflection on the “S” in “ESG”
items.summary: Christen Guddal, Gard’s global head of claims, recently gave a talk at the International Marine Claims Conference in Dublin titled “Putting the S in ESG”. We share some of his comments and observations.
items.summary_zh: Gard 全球理賠主管於國際海事理賠會議中以「ESG 中的 S」為題發表演說，探討海員福祉議題。本文分享其演講中的部分評論與觀察。

items.title: Statsraad Lehmkuhl – the wind and the sails
items.summary: During a voyage from Ishigaki to Manila aboard the tall ship Statsraad Lehmkuhl, our author glimpsed what it means to have wind in our sails. He will take you on that voyage and what we can learn from the master and the crew; the ship and the sea; and the wind and the sails as well as some lessons t
items.summary_zh: 文章敘述Statsraad Lehmkuhl號帆船從石垣島航行至馬尼拉的航程。作者分享與船長及船員學到的經驗，涉及船體、海況、風帆以及所得的啟示。

items.title: Seafarer mental health and geopolitics
items.summary: The IUMI 2022 Policy Forum Workshop in Chicago focused on the war in Ukraine and its impact on marine and war risk insurance.  At the workshop, Gard’s global head of People claims, Lene-Camilla Nordlie, turned her attention to seafarers and the challenges they face, not just due to the current geopo
items.summary_zh: IUMI 2022芝加哥論壇探討烏克蘭戰爭對海險與戰爭險之影響;Gard代表指出海員面臨地緣政治等心理健康挑戰。

items.title: MARPOL compliance and distances ‘from the nearest land’
items.summary: MARPOL permits unprocessed food waste to be discharged into the sea from vessels proceeding at a distance not less than 12 nautical miles from the nearest land. Sounds straightforward? Unfortunately, it is not - all coastal states do not define their ‘nearest land boundary’ in the same way.
items.summary_zh: MARPOL 規定船舶距最近陸地 12 海里以上方可排放未處理廚餘，但各沿海國對「最近陸地邊界」的定義不一致，導致合規判斷存在差異。工務監督應留意各港口國對基線劃分的解釋，避免因距離認定不同而違規。

items.title: War in Ukraine – impact on the maritime situation
items.summary: The security situation in the Black Sea remains unstable, with commercial shipping facing an increased risk of attack. All transits and port calls should therefore be assessed individually, taking account of current threats, available guidance and appropriate mitigating measures.
items.summary_zh: 儘管烏克蘭與俄羅斯之間正在進行和平談判，黑海的安全形勢仍然不穩定。該地區的所有港口進港應根據具體情況進行評估，並參考最佳管理實踐以指導威脅和減輕措施。

items.title: Collision avoidance – safeguarding the lives and livelihoods of fishermen
items.summary: Collisions between merchant vessels and fishing vessels have caused multiple and tragic loss of life. What are the causes and what can be done to prevent such accidents?
items.summary_zh: 商船與漁船碰撞事故已造成多人喪生，凸顯航行安全問題。文章探討事故成因及預防對策，以保障漁民生命與生計。
